title: Senior Backend Engineer - Accounts
description_clean:
In the Global Bank tribe, we're building the infrastructure to provide merchants with a digital business account that empowers them to manage their banking needs. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally with an effortless, simple, and affordable experience.
You'll help us transition from fragmented regional setups to a unified global infrastructure, directly enabling millions of merchants worldwide to access seamless banking tailored to their needs.
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Global Accounts team, you'll own critical pieces of our bank account platform. You'll help us design and build a fully distributed, event-driven system designed to scale across regions with resilience and compliance built in.
You'll work primarily in Kotlin, with opportunities in Elixir and Golang. We practice Extreme Programming: small iterations, daily deliveries, and a focus on technical design quality and deep problem understanding.
Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Golang, Elixir, Java, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes, supported by observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also use AI-assisted development tools including Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
What You'll Do

Build critical infrastructure from scratch: Contribute to the design and implementation of a newly architected global accounts platform. You'll help migrate existing systems to a modern, event-driven, decoupled architecture that enables scalability and resilience across regions.
Master event-driven architecture: You'll be working extensively with Kafka to build a truly decoupled, resilient system. Event-driven architecture is essential to our goal of ensuring that failures in one part of the system don't bring down banking operations globally. This isn't just a technical requirement—it's the foundation of building a platform that can handle the complexities of multi-region banking.

title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
description_clean:
About Agicap
 
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
 
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
 
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
 
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
 
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!
 
Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values
About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.
As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.
You will be responsible for:
Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.
What we are looking for:
Native/Bilingual level of German
2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.
 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
Strong financial situation
Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!
Our benefits:- Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components.
- Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy.
- Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France.
- Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app.
- Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service.
- Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events.




AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Fullstack Engineer
description_clean:
About Sparkify

Sparkify is built by Onstruc UG, a Berlin-based documentation-software company founded in 2020. Onstruc started out building photo-based documentation tools for the construction trade broadly; about two and a half years ago, the team began focusing that experience specifically on electricians, teaming up with Wiha — a German tool manufacturer with 80 years of history and a genuine fan following in the trade — to build the NFC-enabled hardware integration that's now Sparkify's core differentiator.
Electricians are legally required to document their work — photos, forms, measurement data — after every job; Sparkify replaces pen-and-paper and Excel-and-a-prayer with something that works fully offline in the field, and turns taking a measurement into a tap by pulling data straight off Wiha's testing devices via NFC.
Live for 120 days, we're already at 85+ clients and roughly 125 seats, adding about one new client a day -well financed, growing, and shipping fast with a small senior team. We are looking for someone to take clear ownership of our web platform now: backend, frontend, and the production reality in between.

About the role 

You take operational ownership of our production system: PHP 8 / Symfony services and a Vue 3 web client used by electricians every day. You keep the system stable, keep billing flowing, and work through a concrete, prioritized bug and feature backlog end to end.
This is a full-stack ownership role in the practical sense: no backend feature is done until the UI exists, and no frontend flow is complete unless the API, data model, and operational behavior behind it work properly.
This is not a greenfield fantasy, but it is not a legacy horror either. It is a clear, manageable production system with real users, real revenue, and real momentum. You will not be alone: our infrastructure partner supports the Couchbase layer, and you will work closely with our founder, who's covering CTO duties directly, so the system becomes better documented and easier to own over time.

 
What You'll Do

Own the Symfony service fleet: API, auth, payment, notification, image, and PDF-report services; Symfony Messenger for async jobs
Own the web client with it: a Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript SPA using Pinia and Vite
Ship features end to end across checkout, billing, workspace, admin, and documentation flows
Build data import/export support as new hardware-manufacturer partners join the platform
Keep billing flowing: Mollie subscriptions, webhooks, invoices, SEPA mandates
Run and improve production infrastructure: Hetzner servers, GitHub Actions CI, SSH deploys, Cloudflare DNS, Pulumi IaC, and observability via Sentry, Datadog, and Grafana
Work through a real backlog: well-defined bugs, missing endpoints, data cleanups, hardening items, and pragmatic product improvements
Get productive with Couchbase and Sync Gateway, which power our mobile sync. Prior Couchbase experience is helpful, but not required; our managed-service partner's Couchbase engineers support us here

 
What you bring  

At least 5 years' full-stack engineering experience with strong PHP/Symfony, comfortable owning production systems and being trusted with them
Genuinely comfortable with complex, nested JSON and document-based data modeling — our core datastore is document-based (Couchbase), not purely relational; Couchbase itself isn't required on day one, but this general comfort is
Solid modern frontend skills; our SPA is Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript, and deep Vue experience is ideal
Strong engineers coming from React, Angular, Svelte, or similar frameworks are welcome if they can become productive in Vue quickly
Comfortable with Git submodules and a modular, multi-service repo structure
Excellent English, spoken and written; it is our working language
Good German is a plus
E-commerce or payments experience, for example Mollie, Stripe, or similar, is a big plus
DevOps-capable: comfortable with Linux servers, DNS, CI/CD, and production debugging
Pulumi/IaC experience is a plus
Pragmatic, direct, and able to ship without turning everything into a grand redesign

 
Compensation and Perks

A friendly environment with a small team of collaborative and innovative people.
Competitive salary and compensation package.
Home-office friendly, with an office culture we are actively building and expect people to take part in regularly — this is remote-first, not remote-only: a weekly in-person day and the team's daily video standup are part of the role, not an occasional nice-to-have.
You will work directly with the founder, with fast decisions and very little process theater.

description_clean:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Overview
We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.
What You'll Do

Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of industry experience in software development.
Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

title: Engineering Manager, Computing Platform
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to neighborhoods of the world. As part of that mission, we're building a unified platform designed to power DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and future growth. The primary computing platform is mainly a code execution framework that lets product teams compose business logic into graphs, while the team owns the platform, runtime, and operational experience.
We're now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our EU-based Computing Platform team. This is a team of 5 engineers working on a foundational, mission-critical platform that helps simplify backend development at scale by reducing operational overhead for product teams and making cross-team changes easier to build, test, and ship. In this role, you'll grow the team, shape the roadmap, and work closely with product and platform partners and your manager to make the Computing Platform more reliable, performant, and easier to adopt across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.
What you'll be doing
This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of platform strategy, people leadership, and execution. You'll lead a team building core capabilities that help engineers ship business logic without owning the burden of running services themselves. Success in this role means growing a strong team, driving clear priorities, and delivering platform improvements that make the Computing Platform easier for developers, and safer, faster and more reliable to use at massive scale.
Day-to-day in this role you'll:

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, creating clarity, strong execution habits, and a healthy engineering culture.
Own the team's roadmap and delivery across core Computing Platform areas such as performance, scaling and resource management, I/O optimization, integrations, developer experience, and observability.
Partner closely with adjacent platform teams and product domains onboarding to Pedregal, turning their needs into platform capabilities and smoother adoption paths.
Guide architectural and technical decisions for the Computing Platform runtime and developer-facing APIs, balancing reliability, simplicity, and long-term extensibility.
Raise the bar on operational excellence by improving reliability, debuggability, and support for teams running production workloads on the Computing Platform.
Help shape the next phase of the Computing Platform as a foundational platform for Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash through hiring, prioritization, cross-team alignment, and org leadership.

Our humble expectations

At least 3+ years of solid experience as an engineering manager, including directly leading and growing a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment.
At least 5+ years of strong background in backend, infrastructure, product or platform engineering, and good technical judgment when working with distributed systems, runtime platforms, or developer-facing infrastructure.
You know how to turn an ambitious platform vision into clear priorities, pragmatic execution plans, and reliable delivery.
You're comfortable working across team boundaries and partnering with engineering, product, and platform stakeholders to drive alignment and adoption.
You care deeply about people leadership and know how to coach engineers, create clarity, and build a healthy, high-performing team culture.
You hold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and operational excellence, and can help teams navigate production challenges with calm and structure. 

What we offer
This is an opportunity to lead a foundational platform team working on one of the most important backend building blocks. The Computing Platform is designed to simplify how engineers build and operate business logic at scale, and the work of this team has the potential to influence developer productivity, system reliability, and platform adoption across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.
You'll get to work on meaningful engineering leadership challenges with broad scope: growing a strong team, shaping technical direction, and helping define how mission-critical compute platform evolves as more domains onboard. If you're excited by high-leverage platform work, complex distributed systems problems, and the chance to have impact far beyond a single product surface, this is a rare role to step into.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Fundierte Kenntnisse im Data Engineering und praktische Erfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Datenintegration sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.
Gute Kenntnisse in Data Science, explorativer Datenanalyse, statistischen Methoden und der Bewertung datengetriebener Modelle.
Projekterfahrung mit Computer Vision, Bildverarbeitung oder vergleichbaren Machine-Learning-Anwendungen.
Erfahrung mit relationalen, nicht relationalen oder Time-Series-Datenbanken und der Verarbeitung strukturierter sowie unstrukturierter Daten.

title: Brand & Content Lead
description_clean:
In Short: We are looking for someone that loves content and eCommerce to own our entire brand surface — content, community, product marketing, and website — and turn Klar into the go-to resource for actionable eCom knowledge in Europe.
About Klar
🚀 The Mission
Klar is the Data Operating System for growing eCommerce companies, meaning no more spreadsheets. We integrate with all of a brand's data sources to provide a holistic understanding of their business, offering detailed insights on how to accelerate growth and increase profitability.
🛍️ The Reach
We are already the "single source of truth" for over 1,000 leading eCom brands. Market leaders like Sunday Natural, Loop Earplugs, Holy, Maniko, and Armed Angels use Klar to make better decisions every single day.
🤝 The Backstory
We deeply empathize with our customers because we were our customers. The founders (who met in South Africa working for Zando) spent the last 10 years in e-commerce. We know the pain of running these businesses, and we built Klar specifically to solve it.
✨ The Principle
Our guiding principle is Do Work You Are Proud Of. We emphasize long-term quality over short-term results. We evaluate our tools and decisions wisely because we want to be proud of what we build together.
Tasks
About The Position
Klar has two big assets outside of our software: the content we produce and the eCom Unity, Germany's largest eCommerce community with 2,500+ active operators. Both are running today — but honestly, neither is running at the level it could. That's where you come in.
You will own our brand end-to-end and build it into a well-oiled machine. Concretely, that means four areas:
1. The Content Engine
We are in the early stages of building a scalable, consistent content operation, and you will play a major role in deciding what it becomes. You will own the overall direction, identify which formats and channels we should double down on, and turn them into a content engine that ships reliably and at a high bar.
Here is what we are currently thinking:

A weekly newsletter that shares the biggest knowledge bombs from our community, workshops, and own research — no fluff, operational insights only.
A podcast and/or YouTube channel where we go deep with the best operators in eCom on how they actually grow their businesses. Not “here is our founding story” — straight to the operational meat.
Personal branding on LinkedIn for our founders and team members. You will build the system, develop the angles, and yes — write in other people’s voices. If ghostwriting feels beneath you, this is not your role.

You will already have a Content & Video Producer on your team, who is also happy to jump in front of the camera and take ownership beyond production. Together, you will orchestrate the content process from idea to distribution. We work AI-first - a well-set-up Claude gets you 90% of a draft; your judgment, taste, and editing get it to 100%.
2. Community & Events
The eCom Unity runs 20+ IRL events per year like our pre-OMR meetup with 150 operators and a bunch of online workshops. Two people on the team run this today, and it's largely on autopilot — your job is to guide them, connect the community to the content engine (every event is content, every discussion is a newsletter), and push the eCom Unity into its next phase as a genuine media asset.
3. Product Marketing
How we talk about Klar — our positioning, our messaging, and our anti-hype stance in a market full of hype — is something you will own and shape. You will be the strategic counterpart to Max, our founder, who is deeply opinionated on this. Your role is to challenge his perspective, sharpen our thinking, and translate a complex product into clear, compelling messaging that makes its value immediately obvious.
4. Website & Sales Collateral
You own our website (Webflow) and the collateral our sales team needs. You should be able to execute most of this yourself — with Figma, Webflow, and AI tools like Claude Code — and pull in engineering or freelancers when needed.
What success looks like after 12 months: a content machine that ships consistently and at high quality, a growing audience (newsletter, community, social) that considers Klar one of the go-to resources for eCom knowledge in Europe — and a measurable content contribution to our pipeline.
Requirements
About You

You are among the best at what you do - we are looking for extraordinarily talented people who are looking to take their career and knowledge to the next level. You likely have 5–10 years of experience across content, brand, or product marketing.
You are smart & naturally curious - existing in-depth knowledge of eCommerce would be ideal, of course, but we understand that this might be a stretch. Thus, you need to be excited to dig into new industries and gain knowledge of the brands, people and operations in it.
You are a great writer and editor - most content starts as words. You write excellent copy in English (German is a plus), and you have the taste to take an AI-generated draft from good to great. You know the difference.
You are a builder, not just a strategist - you don't need a team of ten to ship. You're comfortable in Webflow, Figma, and AI tools, and you'd rather publish this week than perfect a strategy deck.
You lead through others - you'll guide our community team and work with our video editor. You don't need formal authority to get people moving.
You optimize for learning - your main motivation at this point of your career is to learn as much as possible and broaden your tool set. You want to work with people of the same mindset and learn from each other.

Location: Munich preferred, remote possible.
Benefits
Our Offer
💰 Top-of-Market Compensation
We want to hire the best people out there to help make Klar successful, and we ensure you are compensated accordingly.
🕊️ Freedom & Impact
You will work with founders who truly "get" eCom and are super interested in your ideas. We give you the freedom you need to be successful and the space to take ownership from day one.
🎢 The Full Experience
We offer all the fun, struggle, challenge, and ultimately the elation and satisfaction that comes from building a kick-ass system. We will push you out of your comfort zone and challenge you, guaranteeing a steep personal and professional learning curve.
🔮 Massive Exposure
You get a look "behind the curtain" of how the best eCom brands operate. You will gain detailed insights into the strategies that work, backed by data from hundreds of brands.
🌍 Work From Anywhere
We are building a remote-first company. While we have a base in Munich, you have the flexibility to work from anywhere (ideally within GMT+0 to GMT+4 to keep our collaboration smooth).
🏃 Hiring Process
We are growing like crazy, so we aim to move fast - but we never compromise on quality. A normal process looks like this, but we’re happy to adapt it to your needs and ours:
📑 Application Review -> 👋🏼 First Interview -> 🧩 The Challenge -> 🧠 Deep Dive -> 🤝 Meet the Co-Founders -> 🎉 The Offer.
👋 How To Apply
Simply apply using Join.
Please include a few words (or a video) on why you think you are a great fit — and even better, one piece of content you'd make for Klar in your first month.

Our approach combines laser-cooled ions, microwave and RF control, engineered magnetic field gradients, and advanced theoretical modelling to build scalable quantum processors. description_clean:
Location: Pratau, Germany
On-site
About the position 
As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.
You will:

Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  
You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.

Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!

vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description_clean:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.
GET TO KNOW US
At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!
THE OPPORTUNITY
We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.
YOUR IMPACT

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Proven track record of ensuring a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Fluency in English and German is required. Additional proficiency in either French or Spanish is preferred.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and fluency in English and German are mandatory requirements.
 
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 
CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 
And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.
Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Werkstudent Product Compliance & Quality (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Du willst mit deiner Arbeit etwas bewegen - nicht nur in Theorien oder Reports, sondern an echten Produkten? Du suchst ein Umfeld, in dem Ambition zählt, nicht Hierarchie?
Wir sind GORNATION - eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, den Calisthenics-Sport zu stärken und die Fitness von Menschen weltweit voranzubringen. Heute nutzen hunderttausende Sportler*innen aller Niveaus unsere Produkte in über 100 Ländern. Wir entwickeln eng mit Profis, denken funktional und handeln mit hohen Ansprüchen an uns selbst.
Dafür suchen wir dich: Eine/n Werkstudent*in Product Compliance & Quality, die/der Verantwortung übernimmt, mitdenkt und den Willen hat, Dinge besser zu machen - mit echtem Fokus auf Produktqualität und Compliance. Das ist kein klassischer Werkstudierendenjob: Bei guter Leistung ist eine langfristige Übernahme nach deinem Studienabschluss ausdrücklich vorgesehen.
Du arbeitest in einem motivierten Team, bekommst Raum für Eigenverantwortung und die Chance, wirklich Einfluss zu nehmen. Kein Konzern-Blabla. Kein „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht“. Sondern klarer Pragmatismus, ehrliches Feedback und viel Energie.
Arbeitsmodell: 15-20 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster - weil enge Abstimmung sowie schnelle Entscheidungen im Team live einfach besser funktionieren.
Aufgaben

Produktqualität & QI Reports sichern: Du behältst die Qualität unseres Portfolios über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus im Blick, bewertest Qualitätskontrollen der Produktionschargen und kontrollierst eigenständig Qualitätsinspektions-Reports.
Reklamationen & Feedback auswerten: Du analysierst Kundenfeedback und Reklamationen, erkennst Muster und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungen ab - gemeinsam mit unseren internationalen Herstellern.
Compliance & Normen sicherstellen: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte relevante Normen und gesetzliche Vorgaben in internationalen Märkten einhalten, und arbeitest dich dafür eigenständig in neue Anforderungen ein.
Betriebsanleitungen & Dokumentation: Du erstellst und pflegst rechtssichere Betriebsanleitungen und Produktdokumentationen, normkonform und präzise formuliert.
Tests & Zertifizierungen koordinieren: Du koordinierst Produkttests, Zertifizierungen und Konformitätsbewertungen und behältst dabei Timings und Prioritäten im Blick.

Qualifikation

Organisation, Eigenverantwortung & Tools: Du steuerst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig, priorisierst sauber und arbeitest dabei sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets, um Reports, Feedback oder Timings zu strukturieren.
Compliance- & Normenerfahrung: Du bringst bereits Erfahrung im Compliance- oder Konformitätsbereich mit oder hast Lust, dich zum internen Experten für dieses Thema zu entwickeln.
Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst technische Zeichnungen und Dokumentationen lesen, Erfahrung mit CAD oder SolidWorks ist von Vorteil.
Sprachliche Präzision: Du formulierst normkonform und rechtssicher - auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Pragmatismus & wirtschaftliches Denken: Du gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an und hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Labortests und Zertifizierungen wirklich notwendig sind, um nicht unnötig Geld auszugeben.
Kommunikation & Teamwork: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktentwicklung, Einkauf und Kundensupport zusammen - klar und lösungsorientiert.
Lernbereitschaft & Drive: Du willst wachsen - fachlich und persönlich - und hast Lust, eine Rolle mit echter Verantwortung von Anfang an mitzugestalten.
Calisthenics Bezug: Ein Bezug zur Calisthenics-Szene ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten.
Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder draußen.
Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Wellpass Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug.
Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen.
Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln.
Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben.
Kaffee- & Wasser-Flat: Genieße erstklassigen Kaffee aus unserer hochwertigen Kaffeemaschine und stets frisches Wasser aus unserer Wasserfilteranlage.
Exklusive Rabatte: Profitiere von Mitarbeiterrabatten auf unsere Equipments und Kleidung für dein Training.
Persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Office: Wir setzen auf echte Begegnungen im Büro in Münster statt endloser Online-Calls. Unser Ziel: Ein Office, in dem man sich wohlfühlt und in das man gerne kommt
Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz: Nach Absprache kannst du deinen Hund mit ins Büro nehmen.
E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus: Du kannst dein E-Auto bequem direkt am Office laden.

Wer wir sind
Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015, Büros in Stuttgart und München. Aus hunderten Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstandskunden wissen wir, wie man Software baut, die im Ernstfall trägt.
Seit einer Weile verschiebt sich unser Schwerpunkt Richtung KI: LLM-Anwendungen, RAG, Agenten-Systeme, die beim Kunden wirklich produktiv gehen. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.
Worum es geht
Unsere Kunden sind IT-Dienstleister im öffentlichen Sektor, ein reguliertes Umfeld mit hohen Ansprüchen an Datenschutz und Betriebssicherheit. Dort baust du KI-Lösungen in bestehende Branchenlösungen ein: Dialogsysteme, semantische Suche, RAG-Pipelines, Agenten, alles im echten Produktivbetrieb für viele Nutzer. Projektsprache ist Deutsch.
Ein Wort zu Remote, weil es oft die erste Frage ist: Der Alltag läuft remote-first innerhalb der DACH-Region. Ab und zu bist du vor Ort, den Rest der Zeit arbeitest du von dort, wo du gut arbeitest.
Deine Aufgaben

LLM-Anwendungen bauen. Du entwickelst dialogbasierte Systeme und semantische Suche und integrierst sie in die fachlichen Anwendungen der Branchenlösung.
RAG-Systeme aufsetzen und pflegen. Inklusive Wissensbasis-Management: Indexierung, Aktualisierung, saubere quellengetrennte Ablage von strukturierten und unstrukturierten Inhalten.
Betrieb und Monitoring. MLOps im Produktivbetrieb: Observability, strukturiertes Logging, Fehleranalyse. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Systeme laufen, nicht nur, dass sie einmal liefen.
Agenten produktiv setzen. Von der Entwicklung über die Integration und die Anbindung an Portalsysteme bis zur stabilen Auslieferung.
Auf Datenbasis verbessern. Auf Basis von Monitoring-Daten, Tests und Nutzerfeedback machst du die Lösungen Schritt für Schritt besser.
Neues erproben. Du identifizierst neue KI-Anwendungsfelder, probierst sie aus und baust die Datenpipelines von der Aufbereitung über die Modellerstellung bis in die Produktion.

Das musst du mitbringen
Die folgenden vier Punkte sind harte Voraussetzungen, jeder muss nachweisbar sein. Wenn einer davon fehlt, können wir dich leider nicht ins Rennen schicken. So ehrlich sind wir lieber vorab, als dir Zeit zu stehlen.

Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Machine Learning Engineer in Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung und Optimierung skalierbarer ML-Lösungen.
Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklerteams.
Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift, nachweisbar über ein Sprachzertifikat oder als Muttersprache.
Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, nachweisbar über Zeugnis oder Eigenerklärung.

Das bringst du idealerweise mit
Kein Muss, aber je mehr davon, desto besser:

Vektorsuche und semantische Indexierung in Vektordatenbanken, idealerweise Milvus
Backend-Entwicklung mit Python, vorzugsweise FastAPI
LLM-Orchestrierung mit LangChain oder LangGraph
Betrieb produktionsnaher KI-Systeme: Monitoring (idealerweise Grafana), strukturiertes Logging, Fehleranalyse, Deployment
Datenschutzkonforme KI-Gestaltung, gerade beim Umgang mit personenbezogenen Daten in Logging und Observability
GenAI im Einsatz für viele Nutzer, idealerweise in einem Multimandanten-Umfeld
Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Jenkins
Erfahrung mit agilen Lieferstrukturen, idealerweise SAFe
Erfahrung aus Projekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung

Was wir bieten

Echte Produktivprojekte. KI, die beim Kunden in Betrieb geht. Kein Innovation-Lab, keine Folien.
Remote-first in der DACH-Region. Gelegentlich vor Ort, ansonsten arbeitest du von dort, wo du gut arbeitest.
Moderner KI-Stack. RAG, Agenten, Vektorsuche, MLOps. Aktueller Stack, kein Legacy-Ballast.
Internes Upskilling. Wir investieren in deine KI-Skills.
MacBook, außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware.
Flache Hierarchien. Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner.
Ein Team, das sich kennt, auch bei verteiltem Arbeiten.

Klingt nach dir?
Dann bewirb dich, ein Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wenn du früh verfügbar bist, ist das ein klares Plus. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

We're looking for a Head of Artist Partnerships to help us grow Otherworldly into a world-leading music booking company.
Who we are 👪
We believe live music is one of the best things humans do, and that far more artists deserve to make a living from it than currently can. That's the opportunity we're building for.
The industry still runs on cold emails and who-knows-who, and it's about to be rebuilt. AI now lets small teams achieve incredible things, and we intend to be the team that rebuilds this one.
Otherworldly is an AI-native talent management and booking company. We run an actual roster, meaning real tours, real riders, real settlements, and we're turning everything we've learned into agentic infrastructure. That means a database of 250,000+ bookers worldwide and algorithmic pitching systems that get the right artist in front of the right promoter at scale.
It's working. We closed our seed round with roster and revenue traction already built. Between us, we've managed No.1 artists and Grammy nominees, led strategy for household-name brands, and founded YC-backed companies.
Most music-tech is built by people who've never booked a show. We book shows every week.
Tasks
This is our first dedicated growth hire, and a rare kind of role. You’ll own artist acquisition end-to-end and write the commercial playbook for a category that doesn’t exist yet - next-generation talent management.
You’ll own a number. By the end of next year, the goal is 120+ artist clients. How we get there - which artists, through which doors, with what pitch - is yours to figure out, prove, and turn into a repeatable machine. When it works, you’ll likely hire the next person to run it with you.
You’ll report directly to Alex (CEO) and work side-by-side with the full team in our Berlin office.
Two ways in ✌️
The people we're looking for usually arrive from one of two directions:
🪽From tech, chasing the mission. You've built and scaled at a serious tech company (Series A and beyond) and you're good at it. But you've always wanted your work to serve something you actually love. This is the chance to apply everything you've learnt, in a team that shares your obsession, for clients you believe in.
📈 From music, chasing the ambition. You know this industry from the inside, and you feel boxed in by how slowly it moves. If you're the most ambitious person at your music company and you're ready to help build a world-leading talent company, this is your step up.
What you’ll do

Define and refine our ideal client profile - established, professional musicians. We’re deliberately selective, and you’ll sharpen that selectivity.
Build and run the full outbound pipeline from scratch: research, outreach, qualification, pitch, close
Develop routes to artists through their ecosystem - managers, labels, lawyers, booking agents, publishers
Turn what works into a documented, repeatable acquisition playbook for this specific ICP
Represent Otherworldly at industry events and in the communities where our artists live... much of our deal flow will start with a conversation you begin
Work with the team to find friction in the onboarding handover and eliminate it

Requirements
You’ll thrive here if
🌍 You live in both worlds. You have 3–7 years in business development, partnerships, or sales, ideally at a tech company serving musicians or creators, and you know how to hold a real conversation with an established artist, their manager, their label, or their lawyer

title: Transport Automation & Analytics Expert
description_clean:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.
At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.
Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!
We are currently looking for a Transport Automation & Analytics Expert who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with the Head of Global Transport, your focus will be on designing and optimising transport planning logic, analytics, reporting, and automation across all modes. In this role, you will combine your appreciation for operational insight with your capacity for strategic decision-making and process design. You will develop skills crucial to advancing a lean, centralised, and data-driven transport operation, all within a company that prizes dedication and results.
What you will do
Support the improvement of global transport planning logic across all transport modes, including routing principles, mode selection, service rules, allocation logic, and network assumptions.
Build scenario models and analytical tools to support decisions on cost, service, lead times, carrier mix, routing changes, service promises, contingency options, and network design.
Contribute to the analytical preparation of transport tenders, including lane strategy, bid packs, pricing comparison models, evaluation logic, award scenarios, and recommendations, working closely with operational leads and mode experts.
Develop and enhance transport dashboards, data models, KPI reporting, scalable data structures, and automation workflows using tools such as Power BI, Superset, BigQuery, Supabase, and n8n.
Identify and test practical opportunities to apply analytics, automation, and AI-enabled decision support to improve data quality, reduce manual work, strengthen operational decision-making, and deliver cost, service, and risk improvements.
What you should bring
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. An advanced degree or relevant thesis is desirable.
Experience or demonstrated knowledge in transport, logistics, warehousing, supply chain, data analytics, automation, or related areas, gained through professional, academic, internship, or personal projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex data, identify patterns, and translate operational requirements into practical solutions.
Experience with tools such as Power BI, Superset, BigQuery, SQL, or similar analytics and automation technologies, together with an interest in practical AI applications.
A proactive, curious, and delivery-focused mindset, with strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions and work cross-functionally with minimal supervision.
What we can offer you

A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.

description_clean:

Willkommen bei CADAICO, der Heimat für neugierige Entwickler:innen, KI-Nerds, Geeks und Engineering Talente.
# Es werden nur Bewerbungen mit Anschreiben berücksichtigt. #
Ein großer Teil unserer Arbeit ist, aus sehr unterschiedlichen Eingaben – Text, Zeichnungen, technischen Unterlagen – möglichst vollständig alle Informationen herauszuholen und sauber zusammenzuführen.
Schreib uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wo du sowas schon gebaut hast: Was waren die Herausforderungen dabei, und wie hast du sie gelöst?
Unser Dev-Team ist klein, aber sehr fein – zwei, drei Leute. Deine Arbeit ist unmittelbar sichtbar und zählt vom ersten Tag an. Wer echte Verantwortung sucht, ist hier richtig.
Unser Startup
CADAICO, die Chat-to-Design Company, ist ein Startup aus Stuttgart, das von Pedram, einem ehemaligen Mid-Level Manager aus dem Maschinenbau, und Daniel, einem KI-Forscher vom KIT gegründet wurde.
Unser Team baut Software, die KI-Methoden mit herkömmlichen Algorithmen kombiniert – damit Ingenieur:innen im Maschinenbau ihre Konstruktionen automatisiert erstellen können, statt manuell mit CAD-Tools.
Mit vielversprechenden Projekten in der Pipeline haben wir eine gute Grundlage für die nächste Wachstumsphase und suchen dafür Menschen, die selbstständig denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und echte KI-Produkte bauen wollen, die den Maschinenbau prägen.
Aufgaben
Was du bei uns machst

Baue das KI-Herz unseres Chat-to-Design Produkts schrittweise weiter:
von der LLM-Anbindung bis zum produktiven Agenten
Sorge dafür, dass unsere Software kundenspezifisch lernt, ohne dass ein Modell trainiert wird – über versionierte System-Prompts, Wissensbasen, Regelwerke, Feedback- und Memory-Systeme. Kundenspezifik über Architektur anstatt über Gewichtung
Bring unserem Produkt bei, aus wenigen, sehr unterschiedlichen Eingaben – auch nicht-textuellen – verlässlich alle Informationen herauszuholen und in strukturierten Output zu überführen – samt der nötigen Retrieval- und Wissensbausteine über Konstruktions- und Bauteildaten
Erstelle Agentic Workflows: Tool Use, Function Calling, mehrstufiges Reasoning und robuste Fehlerbehandlung
Setze komplexe KI-Ideen in zuverlässige, produktive Softwarefeatures um – gemeinsam mit unseren Engineers.

Qualifikation
Was du mitbringen solltest

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python und sauberes, wartbares Engineering – Typing, Tests, verständliche APIs
Erfahrung damit, aus unstrukturierten oder mehrdeutigen Eingaben strukturierte, verlässliche Ergebnisse zu machen – idealerweise auch aus nicht-textuellen Quellen (Bilder, Dokumente, technische Unterlagen)

Du hast schon mehr gebaut als einen Chatbot: ein System, in dem ein Sprachmodell etwas tut – Tools aufruft, über eigene Daten arbeitet oder mehrere Schritte verkettet. Ob im Job, im Studium oder im eigenen Projekt, ist uns egal

Sehr gutes Englisch und gute Deutschkenntnisse für eine sichere interne und externe Kommunikation
Eine bestehende Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland. Als kleines Team können wir leider keine Visa-Unterstützung leisten.

Du übernimmst von Oktober 2026 bis September 2027 die Weiterentwicklung unseres BCM (Business Continuity Management):

Du hast Interesse und Motivation Themen von Beginn bis zur Realisierung zu denken und umzusetzen und scheust dich nicht vor komplexeren Zusammenhängen und langfristigen Aufgaben.
Du denkst dich gerne in neue oder sich ändernde regulatorische Anforderungen ein und bist bereit dich thematisch weiterzuentwickeln.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein internationales / grenzüberschreitendes Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet.
Kleines Team - Einfluss auf die Teamkultur und das Produkt.

Coaching und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.

title: Senior Product Manager - House Owner & Service Request Acquisition (all genders)
description_clean:
Responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.
Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match. It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching. The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.
At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.
As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.

You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.
You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.

Skills

You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.
You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.
You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.
You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.
You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.
You bring order into chaos by bringing together diverse perspectives, challenges, and priorities to establish shared understanding and strong alignment across teams, and you are comfortable chairing decisions no single team owns.
You think entrepreneurially and achieve your goals with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.
You follow the latest trends in product management and technology, are an absolute team player, and your excellent communication skills in English (and German as a nice-to-have), along with a good sense of humor, characterize you.

What we offer
Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.
Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.
Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.
Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.
Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.
